title: The Bullwhip Effect in Supply Networks
authors: Nikolay Osadchiy; William Schmidt; Jing Wu
near_miss_reason: Customer-base events (Add, Drop, Swap) occur at firm-specific quarters, but the causal analysis (Equation (7), Table 10; Table 11 moderators) regresses the change in a firm's demand variability around each event quarter (post- minus pre-window SD of COGS) on an event indicator in a 1:1 CEM-matched sample of event and control firm-quarters (matched on event quarter), with no firm FE; cols 1/4/7 have no controls or FE, other columns add time-varying firm controls and industry and quarter-year FE. Firms can have multiple events. This is a stacked matched event-window design, not a unit x calendar-time TWFE panel.
eligible_reason: No qualifying column: stacked, CEM-matched event-window first-difference regressions without firm FE (Table 10), repeated non-absorbing events; and the FactSet Revere and Compustat data are licensed and not shipped.
design_notes: 3A_Analysis.do: regress sd_cogsDiff4 i.treatnow4 if vars_present==1 & k2k==1, vce(cluster cusip) (Table 10 col 1); + ctrls (col 2); + i.year_qtr i.sic2 (col 3); analogous 8- and 12-quarter windows in 3A_Analysis_as.do and 3A_Analysis_drop.do. Model-free paired comparisons in Table 6.
data_files_note: README: FactSet Revere (2003-2015) and Compustat quarterly must be obtained from FactSet/WRDS; only auxiliary mapping files shipped.
data_provenance_note: Licensed FactSet Revere and Compustat data not included.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2020.3824.txt). README table numbers (Tables 9-10) are from an earlier draft; published Table 10 is the main matched regression. Batch metadata lacked title/authors/year; filled from the article text.
